description.en: In first semester,  Junior students can choose to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. When they are finishing the course that can get the credit, also can account in graduate credit. For Senior level, Classes are giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 鋼筋混凝土材料及其力學性質；鋼筋混凝土構材受到軸向力、彎曲力矩、剪力、扭轉力矩及握裹力作用時之分析；依據鋼筋混凝土設計規範之規定，將理論於梁、版、柱、基腳等構物設計之概述。
description.en: Behavior and design of reinforced concrete members.Materialproperties;design methods and safety considerations;flexure;shear;bond and anchorage;combined flexure and axial load;footings;introduction to torsion,slender columns,and prestressed concrete.

description.zh: 基礎工程係應用土壤力學之原理於基礎問題之分析，其內容包括下列各項：(1) 基礎之定義：功用及其重要性、(2) 土壤調查、(3) 基礎之水、防水及開挖、(4) 基礎之承載力、5) 基礎之應力分析與沈陷計算 (6) 基腳及筏式基礎、(7) 樁基、(8) 墩基、(9) 沈箱基礎、(10) 基礎穩定處理。
description.en: Subsurface investigations and synthesis of soil parameters for geotechnical design and analysis,concepts of shallow and deep foundation design,geotechnical design of conventional retaining walls,computerized analysis and design of soil/foundation interaction;case histories.

description.zh: 本課程主要教授學生力法、位法及矩陣之基本應用：(1) 傾角變位法、(2) 力矩分配法、(3) 能與補能之觀念、(4) 矩陣結構力法、(5) 矩陣結構變位法、(6) 直接勁度法、(7) 結構穩定之介紹 。
description.en: Fundamental theory of statically indeterminate structures;analysis of indeterminate beams,frames,and trusses by stiffness and flexibility methods;study of influence lines for beams,frames,and trusses.

description.zh: 使學生了解工程管理之應用範圍，並深入研習各領域所相關之管理技能與知識；並藉由範例之演算，使學生能與實務相結合，俾能有效的將管理技巧與電腦科技靈活的應用於工程現場之中。
description.en: This course helps to develop students' skills in managing construction projects. This course may be taken at different views in a construction management program with an emphasis on residential or commercial construction. Specific contents may include schedule management, job-site safety management, cost management, and related management topic in construction. Specific computer software may be used for construction project management. Students typically obtain the real experience from the practice special talk to gain real-world experience in planning and scheduling construction projects.

description.zh: 本課程為土木學門之基礎課程，目的在講授水文定性現象，及相關水文循環過程之定量計算理論。課程內容涵蓋地球上水的發生、循環、分佈、物理與化學特性以及和所有生物間的關係；並藉由工程觀點，依照水文循環特性進行系統化介紹，培養學生具有基礎水文能力，應用水文學原理解決人類在水資源開發所面臨的問題。
description.en: This foundational course for the civil engineering covers both qualitative hydrological phenomena elaboration and quantitative assessment theories related to the processes of hydrological cycle. It aims to prepare students with basic hydrological knowledge and skills to apply hydrology principles in problem-solving of water resources development.

notes: 請勿排二教或四教教室

description.zh: 1.	流體力學試驗為流體力學現象與理論之橋樑，藉由實驗過程可加強流體力學之觀念。2.	學習並加強科技報告之寫作與基本之組織技巧及團體合作。
description.en: 1. Fluid mechanics experiments aim to bridge the fluid mechanics phenomena and theory. The concepts of fluid mechanics will be delivered and strengthened through the experimental process.2. Learn and improve technical report writing, basic organizational skills and teamwork.

notes: 土木館 3F 水工實驗室

description.zh: 由於近年來電腦科技發展迅速，在透過地理資訊系統的幫助下，圖文整合的資料庫型態，已有相當完整成熟的作業方式。本課程將針對地理資訊系統的應用功能方向，分別剖析其主要架構與理論。同時配合相關地理資訊系統軟體，建立學員實作能力。
description.en: Operational and management issues in planning management analysis,locational decision making,and design implementation of GIS.Lab project emphasizes student'sspecialization.

notes: 土木三甲乙合開/上限 40 人/土木館 106

description.zh: 環境規與管理是一門跨學科極為重要的整合性課程，討論內容包括：(1) 環境問題與社會、(2) 環境經濟學、(3) 環境政策、(4) 環境規劃原理與方法、(5) 環境質量管理、(6) 環境保護規劃技術、(7) 環境影響評估、(8) 土地利用與國土規劃、(9) 區域性環境管理、(10) 都市環境之管理、(11) 環境保護管理制度、(12) 自然資源與景觀維護以及永續發展之環境管理等。
description.en: Environmental Planning and Management aims to study the relationship between environmental problems and social, economics and ecology. The theory and technology of planning are also described. The environmental impact assessment is a major method for the approching of balance between economical development and environmental protection, therefore it is stressed to state it's contents and assessment methods. Further the National planning and City planning in the area of environmental espects are also described in the course. It intends to let the students realize how to have a sustainable development under the policy of environmental protection.

notes: 土木三甲乙合開 / 上限 40 人

description.zh: 伴隨著台灣經濟高度發展， 地下水資源在民生、工業及民生用水所扮演的角色日益重要。地下水學科的領域涵蓋水量、水質及防災三方面。修習此課程，學生可以了解地下水文及水井水力學之基本原理，推估區域性地下水蘊藏量及安全出水量，以作為規劃與管理地下水資源之依據。
description.en: As the economy in Taiwan develops, groundwater resources play an increasingly important role in both industry and domestic water supply. The discipline of groundwater covers three aspects: water quantity, water quality and disaster prevention. This course mainly introduces the basic principles of groundwater hydrology and well hydraulics, and tackles how to estimate the amount of regional groundwater resources and determine their safe yield, as a basis for planning and managing groundwater resources.

notes: 土木三甲乙合開/上限 40 人/適合大三大四修讀

description.zh: 修完「學院指定向度課程」12 學分後，剩餘 6 學分可在人文與藝術向度、社會與法治向度、自然與科學向度及創新與創業向度自由修滿，達到通識畢業 18 學分。
description.en: After completing 12 credits “designated by the college”, the remaining 6 credits are open for selection form these curriculums: humanities and art, social and legal, nature and science and innovation and entrepreneurship, until a total of 18 credits of the general curriculum are completed for graduation.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技三年級上學期實施選修專項分組教學，課程修畢有一學分並計入畢業學分內。由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: In first semester,  Junior students can choose to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. When they are finishing the course that can get the credit, also can account in graduate credit. For Senior level, Classes are giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 鋼筋混凝土材料及其力學性質；鋼筋混凝土構材受到軸向力、彎曲力矩、剪力、扭轉力矩及握裹力作用時之分析；依據鋼筋混凝土設計規範之規定，將理論於梁、版、柱、基腳等構物設計之概述。
description.en: Behavior and design of reinforced concrete members.Materialproperties;design methods and safety considerations;flexure;shear;bond and anchorage;combined flexure and axial load;footings;introduction to torsion,slender columns,and prestressed concrete.

description.zh: 基礎工程係應用土壤力學之原理於基礎問題之分析，其內容包括下列各項：(1) 基礎之定義：功用及其重要性、(2) 土壤調查、(3) 基礎之水、防水及開挖、(4) 基礎之承載力、5) 基礎之應力分析與沈陷計算 (6) 基腳及筏式基礎、(7) 樁基、(8) 墩基、(9) 沈箱基礎、(10) 基礎穩定處理。
description.en: Subsurface investigations and synthesis of soil parameters for geotechnical design and analysis,concepts of shallow and deep foundation design,geotechnical design of conventional retaining walls,computerized analysis and design of soil/foundation interaction;case histories.

description.zh: 本課程主要教授學生力法、位法及矩陣之基本應用：(1) 傾角變位法、(2) 力矩分配法、(3) 能與補能之觀念、(4) 矩陣結構力法、(5) 矩陣結構變位法、(6) 直接勁度法、(7) 結構穩定之介紹 。
description.en: Fundamental theory of statically indeterminate structures;analysis of indeterminate beams,frames,and trusses by stiffness and flexibility methods;study of influence lines for beams,frames,and trusses.

description.zh: 使學生了解工程管理之應用範圍，並深入研習各領域所相關之管理技能與知識；並藉由範例之演算，使學生能與實務相結合，俾能有效的將管理技巧與電腦科技靈活的應用於工程現場之中。
description.en: This course helps to develop students' skills in managing construction projects. This course may be taken at different views in a construction management program with an emphasis on residential or commercial construction. Specific contents may include schedule management, job-site safety management, cost management, and related management topic in construction. Specific computer software may be used for construction project management. Students typically obtain the real experience from the practice special talk to gain real-world experience in planning and scheduling construction projects.

description.zh: 本課程為土木學門之基礎課程，目的在講授水文定性現象，及相關水文循環過程之定量計算理論。課程內容涵蓋地球上水的發生、循環、分佈、物理與化學特性以及和所有生物間的關係；並藉由工程觀點，依照水文循環特性進行系統化介紹，培養學生具有基礎水文能力，應用水文學原理解決人類在水資源開發所面臨的問題。
description.en: This foundational course for the civil engineering covers both qualitative hydrological phenomena elaboration and quantitative assessment theories related to the processes of hydrological cycle. It aims to prepare students with basic hydrological knowledge and skills to apply hydrology principles in problem-solving of water resources development.

description.zh: 1.	流體力學試驗為流體力學現象與理論之橋樑，藉由實驗過程可加強流體力學之觀念。2.	學習並加強科技報告之寫作與基本之組織技巧及團體合作。
description.en: 1. Fluid mechanics experiments aim to bridge the fluid mechanics phenomena and theory. The concepts of fluid mechanics will be delivered and strengthened through the experimental process.2. Learn and improve technical report writing, basic organizational skills and teamwork.

notes: 土木館 3F 水工實驗室

For Senior level, Classes are giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 學生與教授討論擬定之研究題目, 在教授個別指導下, 進行實驗之研究, 以培養學生尋找相關資料, 文獻及獨立研究的訓練, 並將其研究成果撰寫成報告並公開發表練習。
description.en: Students discuss and propose research topics with professors. Under the individual guidance of professors, they conduct experiments to cultivate students' abilities to seek relevant information, literature, and conduct independent research. They then write up their research findings into reports and present a final report publicly.

description.zh: 本課程針對各種材料（金屬、陶瓷、高分子、複合材料）之基本原理，性質及應用，做概要性的介紹。內容包括材料之晶體結構與晶體缺陷，固體材料之原子擴散，相圖與相變化，材料製程及應用，材料之物理性質（光性質、電性質、磁性質及熱性質），材料之機械性質（強度、延展性、硬度、韌性、疲勞、潛變）。
description.en: This course targets at the brief introduction to the fundamental principles, characteristics and application of the metal, ceramics, polymer and composite material. This course includes the crystal structure and defect, atomic diffusion of the solid materials, phase diagrams and phase transformation, material manufacturing process and application, the physic property (optical, electrical, magnetic and thermal property), mechanical property (strength, ductility, hardness, toughness, fatigue, and creep).

description.zh: 教授化學儀器分析原理、應用、儀器裝置及限制, 準確度等。內容有紅、可見、紫外、X 光 、核磁共振光譜、表面分析之電子質譜方法、熱分析以及不同的分析方法如 、液體層析等。
description.en: This text will introduce the fundamental principles and Applications of modern Analytical instruments.Measuring devices, limitations of measurements in terms of sensitivity and accuracy will also be taught. The contents are infrared, visible, ultraviolet, X-ray and nuclear magnetic spectroscopes, Analysis of sur-faces with electron beams and mass spectrometry, thermal methods and chromatography and related separation methods.

description.zh: 介紹氣體的物理性質，熱力學第一、第二與第三定律，化學反應之熱能變化與動力學，以及系統中的相平衡。
description.en: This course contents the following subjects: the physical properties of gases, the first law, second law and third law of thermodynamics, enthalpy change in chemical reaction, chemical kinetic and the phase equilibria in a system.

notes: 原周三第 2 節, 擬調整為周五第 2 節

description.zh: 本課程包含兩個部分。一、討論各種纖維之化學組成、合成與成形之理論，同時針對纖維之性質、纖維改質與組成、合成、成形間之關係與影響因素及檢測加以講授。 二、說明纖維之形態與微觀及巨觀結構、纖維長度分佈與斷面、密度、吸水性與膨潤性、機械性質、光學性質、熱性質，黏彈性質，及電氣性質等物理性質及其測試。
description.en: This course includes two parts. Part 1: A major object of this course is to provide a background in fiber compositions, synthesis, spinning and characterization. A second goal is to introduce factors that influence fiber compositions, formation and properties and their testing. Part 2: The course interprets the following subjects, such as: (1) Morphology of the fibers. (2) Microstructure and macrostructure of fibers. (3) Staple fiber length and cross-section. (4) Fiber density and absorption. (5) Mechanical properties. (6) Optical properties. (7) Thermal properties. (8) Fiber Viscoelasticity. (9) Electrical properties etc and their testing.

description.zh: 研究複合材料原理及應用，複合材料之高分子科學，預浸料，模壓料，壓力釜成型與真空袋技術，繞線成型，編織成型，熱可塑複合材料，拉擠成型及複合材料力學及應用。
description.en: The aim of this course is to learn the principle of composite and its application.  Several composite processing methods are included.They are prepregs, molding compounds, autoclave and vaccum bag method.  Filament winding, braiding, thermoplastic composite, pultrusion are also included.  Finally, mechanic of composite and its application are discussed in detaile.

description.zh: 本門授課之目的在介紹各種有機化合物之合成方法、原理及應用，並探討有機實驗室常用之有機反應及其反應機構。
description.en: The course introduces various kinds of organic synthetic methods, principles and applications.  The most commonly used organic reactions and their mechanisms are also discussed.

description.en: The lab course is designed for supplementing the lecture course'Communication Systems' and 'Digital Communication Systems'.sStudents can learn the principles and practive of analog and digital communication systems from laboratory experiments and projects.The cintents include1.measuremnts of signals in time domain and frequency domain 2.design of analog filters3.double sideband AM systems4.single sideband AM systems5.FM systems6.dessign of phase-locked-loop detectors7.sampling and regeneration of analog signals8.pulse amplitude modulation(PAM)systems9.pulse coded modulation(PCM)systems10.digital passband transmission11.multiplexing systems12.design and simulation of communication systems

description.zh: 使學生熟悉，應用程式設計之環境、方法、及原則，內容含：（１）作業系統與應用程式之關係（２）視窗環境（３）網路環境（４）整合設計學生將窗撰寫完整之應用程式
description.en: To familiarize the student with the environments,methodologies,and principles of application softwaredesign.Topics include :1.Run-time environments2.Window environments3.Networking environments4.Integrated designThe student will write application programs with actual function.

description.zh: 本課程由學生與老師共同選定題目，在特定題目下對此專題之問題定義，分析，推理，設計，製作與解決方法進行研究，以完成該專題之成品，專題完成後需撰寫書面報告並公開展示成品，以培養實務工作之能力。專題範圍包含：1. 電子電路，2. 電子儀表，3. 控制與通訊系統，4. 電子視聽系統，5. 微電腦為基礎之計算機硬體（含軟體）製作，6. 軟體設計與製作（PC，工作站），影像處理與計算機視覺，多媒體製作（動畫、Video、Audio 及其整合），9. 其他。
description.en: In this course,students will conduct special project under the guidance of his advisor.The topic of this project,selected and decided by bath the student and his advisor,could be chosen form(but not limited to)1.Electronic circuits2.Electronic instrumentation3.Communication and control systems4.Microprocessor applications5.Multimedia system designs6.Computer networks7.Computer software desgin

description.zh: 專題報告專題演講 研究小組討論
description.en: Case Study. Seminar. Group meeting.

description.zh: 1. 資料表示法：定點系統 (Fixed Point System)，浮點系統 (Floating Point System)，2. 運算工作：定點之加減乘除，快速之運算，浮點運算，3. 指令與控制：各種指令介紹，中斷，硬體控制單元設計 (Hardwired Control)，微程式控制單元設計 (Microprogramming)，4. 記憶系統：記憶體之層次 (Memory Hierarchy)，虛擬記憶系統 (Virtualmemory)，快速記憶 (Cache Memory)。

description.zh: 1. 傅利葉分析與訊號取樣，2. 離散時序系統之頻率響應與電路設計， 3. Infinite Impulse Response 數位濾波器設計：Bilinear 轉換式，Impulse-invariance 方式，Step-invariance 方式，高通、帶通、帶拒濾波器轉換式，4.Finite Impulse Response 數位濾波器設計：FourierSeries 方法，Window 方法，5. 離散與快速傅利葉轉換：DFT、FFT 等演算法。
description.en: 1.Fourier analysis and signal sampling2.Frequcy response of discrete time system3.IIR digital filter design4.FIR digital filter design5.Discrete fourier transform6.Fast fourier transform

description.zh: 1. 時變電磁場之介紹; 2. 平面電磁波; 3. 傳輸線之理論及應用; 4. 導波管與共振腔; 5. 天線與輻射系統。
description.en: 1.Introduction to Time-Varying Fields;2.Plane Electromagnetic Waves;3.Theory and Applications of Transmission Lines;4.Waveguides and Resonators;5.Antennas and Radiating Systems.

description.zh: 本課程探討現代通訊的基本原理，內容重點放在類比通訊的調變技巧與雜訊分析．課程大綱包括：1. 簡介 2. 信號與系統 3. 機率、隨機程序與雜訊 4. 振幅調變：雙旁波帶、調幅、單旁波帶與殘旁波帶 5. 角度調變：頻率調變與相位調變 6. 脈波調變：脈幅調變、脈寬調變、脈位調變、脈碼調變與步差調變 7. 數位通訊簡介對於數位通訊有進一步興趣的同學可繼續選修『數位通訊系統』課程
description.en: Fundamental principles of modern communication will be investigated in depth in this course, with emphasis on analog communications.Basic modulation techniques will be introduced with nosie analysis.Contents include1.Introduction 2.Signals and Systems3.Probability ,Random Process,and Nosie4.Amplitude Modulations:DSB,AM,SSB,and VSB5.Angle Modulations:FMand PM6.Pulse Modulations:PAM,PWM,PPM,PCM,and DM7.Intorduction to Digital Communication Students who want to know more details sbout digital commmunication are encouraged to take the course Digital Communication Systems

description.zh: 1. 積體電路的分類，2. 積體電路晶片設計的流程，3.CMOS 元件的基本結構與佈局，4.CMOS 元件的設計規範技術，5.CMOS 元件組成各種數位電路，6. 以高階方法探討積體電路之設計，7. 系統分割，8. 設計問題之探討，9.IC 的構造， 10. 設計方法，11. 時序問題之探討，12. 鐘脈問題之探討，13.VLSI 之測試，14. 有助於設計與測試的結構化技巧探討，15. 專題製作。

description.en: After completing 12 credits “designated by the college”, the remaining 6 credits are open for selection form these curriculums: humanities and art, social and legal, nature and science and innovation and entrepreneurship, until a total of 18 credits of the general curriculum are completed for graduation.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技三年級上學期實施選修專項分組教學，課程修畢有一學分並計入畢業學分內。由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: In first semester,  Junior students can choose to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. When they are finishing the course that can get the credit, also can account in graduate credit. For Senior level, Classes are giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.en: The lab course is designed for supplementing the lecture course'Communication Systems' and 'Digital Communication Systems'.sStudents can learn the principles and practive of analog and digital communication systems from laboratory experiments and projects.The cintents include1.measuremnts of signals in time domain and frequency domain 2.design of analog filters3.double sideband AM systems4.single sideband AM systems5.FM systems6.dessign of phase-locked-loop detectors7.sampling and regeneration of analog signals8.pulse amplitude modulation(PAM)systems9.pulse coded modulation(PCM)systems10.digital passband transmission11.multiplexing systems12.design and simulation of communication systems

description.zh: 使學生熟悉，應用程式設計之環境、方法、及原則，內容含：（１）作業系統與應用程式之關係（２）視窗環境（３）網路環境（４）整合設計學生將窗撰寫完整之應用程式
description.en: To familiarize the student with the environments,methodologies,and principles of application softwaredesign.Topics include :1.Run-time environments2.Window environments3.Networking environments4.Integrated designThe student will write application programs with actual function.

description.zh: 本課程由學生與老師共同選定題目，在特定題目下對此專題之問題定義，分析，推理，設計，製作與解決方法進行研究，以完成該專題之成品，專題完成後需撰寫書面報告並公開展示成品，以培養實務工作之能力。專題範圍包含：1. 電子電路，2. 電子儀表，3. 控制與通訊系統，4. 電子視聽系統，5. 微電腦為基礎之計算機硬體（含軟體）製作，6. 軟體設計與製作（PC，工作站），影像處理與計算機視覺，多媒體製作（動畫、Video、Audio 及其整合），9. 其他。
description.en: In this course,students will conduct special project under the guidance of his advisor.The topic of this project,selected and decided by bath the student and his advisor,could be chosen form(but not limited to)1.Electronic circuits2.Electronic instrumentation3.Communication and control systems4.Microprocessor applications5.Multimedia system designs6.Computer networks7.Computer software desgin

description.zh: 本課程之目的為使學生瞭解生產計畫與管制的基本概念，訓練學生對於生產計畫與管制的各項方法，制度設計及改善等具有基本認識，並應用管理科學及作業研究於生產計畫與管制之研究發展。本課程包括下列主題：生產計畫與管制概論、產品設計與發展、預測、來源需求規畫、生產排程、總排程、存貨管理、豐田式管理、專案規畫與管理等。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to introduce the fundamental concepts of production planning and control.  In addition, applications of management science and operations research in production control and planning are also provided.  This course is consisted of the following subjects: introduction, product design and development, forecasting, resources requirement planning, production scheduling, total scheduling, inventory management, Toyota management, and project management.

description.zh: 指導學生進行研究專題，以培育其實務的能力，學生必須選定一實務專題，由本系教師指導，在畢業前完成成品製作，且須有書面報告。
description.en: Teaching students to do the research work and to write the papers. Before graduation, the students have possessed the ability to do the R/D work. Each student must be through professor's instrution's instructions to select the topics of special project, personal or group work should be completed the project's hardware or software and issued the paper. An announcement has been made by the department, then get the grade and credit.

description.zh: 本課程在二技為品質管理。使學生瞭解品質管理的觀念、原理、領域。品管部門的組織、功能，如何管理產品或服務的品質，品管的工具、方法，如何持續改善品質的方法，品質表示法，如何評估品質管理成效，相關法令，品質管理未來趨勢。
description.en: This course lets the students understand the concepts, theories, and areas of qualify control, organization and functions of quality department.  Besides, the way to manage the products or the service quality, tools and methods of quality control, the way to improve the quality, quality representation method, evaluation of quality control, related regulations and future trends are also included.

description.zh: 本課程的目的一，將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別為：從全球化角度認知社會可接受的商業行為，將待人和善深植於良好的企業中，企業形象再造，強化職業倫理以及投資於可持續發展和有社會責任的公司。本課程亦教導學生瞭解今日快速變化工商界，符合企業倫理的公司治理原則與方式。課程的教導將朝下列五個方向進行：（1）廠商的社會責任，（2）消費者的保護，（3）員工的權益，（4）員工對公司的責任，（5）雇主與員工關係。目的二，進一步教授 ESG 及聯合國 SDGs 指標的基本定義，藉由國、內外的個案討論來深根學生對於企業永續經營的觀念。
description.en: The first objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: recognizing socially acceptable business conduct from the global perspectives, embedding good business in treating people nice and fair, reengineering corporate image, enhancing professional ethics, and investing in sustainable and socially responsible corporations. This course also discusses with the students the corporate governance that follows business ethics in today's changing business society. Five major categories will be covered: (1) Corporate social responsibility, (2) Consumer protection, (3) Employee's rights and benefits, (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms, and (5) Employer-employee relations.The second objective is to further explain the definitions of ESG and SDGs, and then to root the concept of sustainable management to students through local and international case studies.

description.zh: 當企業在邁向資訊化與自動化的同時，智慧生產工程師需考量如何整合智慧製造與精實生產。本課程的目標在幫助學生瞭解智慧製造在工廠上的應用，學習建構所謂精實導向的企業。
description.en: Since business are moving toward information and automation, smart production engineers need to consider how to integrate smart manufacturing and lean production. The goal of this course is to help students understand the application of smart manufacturing in the factory and to learn to build a so-called lean-oriented enterprise.

description.zh: 本課程適用於一般大專之決策分析課程。其目的在說明決策理論之基本觀念，及其在真實世界裡相關決策問題之分析。本課程授課主題包括：不考慮機率之決策問題、與機率有關之決策問題、獲取額外資訊之決策分析、效益分析、遊戲理論。相關之授課內容包括：機率分配、期望值方法、貝氏分析、完全資訊與額外資訊之期望值。
description.en: This is an undergraduate course dealing with decison making and analysis.The objective of this course is to interpret the basic concepts of decision theory and its applications on some real world decision analysis problims.The main topics of this course include decision making without probability,decision making with probability,decison analysis with additional information,utility theory,gametheory.The related studies includes prlbability distribution,expected value approach,Bayesian analysis,expected value of perfect informatin and sample information.

description.zh: 排程主要在規劃與排定活動執行的優先順序，以使各項資源得到最佳的運用。本課程主要在介紹生產排程的基本理論與方法，使學生奠定排程研究與排程實務問題解決的基礎。
description.en: Scheduling consists of planning and prioritizing activities that need to be performed in an orderly sequence of operation. It is a tool that optimizes use of available resources. This course focuses on the basic concept on scheduling. The purpose of this course is to guide the students to learn the basic methodologies of scheduling, and to understand the scheduling application aspects.

description.zh: 本課程預計搭配中國工業工程學會的「永續工程師」證照檢定考試做授課，由工程面與管理面探討淨零排放趨勢下，企業永續下工業工程所需具備的能力與知識。其中管理篇包括：企業永續發展、永續發展與氣候變遷風險管理、碳中和浪潮與因應之道、綠色供應鏈管理、永續金融、氣候相關財務揭露建議、資源永續與產業共生、與永續經濟決策分析。工程篇則包括：永續供應鏈設計、永續與能源政策、排放權交易與碳定價、綠色產品設計與評估、綠色物流與綠色冷鏈、產品服務系統、綠色聰明生產與循環經濟、清潔生產等理論與案例實務。
description.en: This course is designed to cover the knowledge and skills required for sustainable industrial in the context of net-zero emissions. It will be taught in conjunction with the "Sustainable Engineer" certification exam of the Chinese Institute of Industrial Engineers. The course will explore the topics from both engineering and management perspectives, focusing on sustainable enterprise development. The management chapters will cover a range of areas such as climate change, sustainable finance, green supply chain, carbon-neutral strategies, climate-related financial disclosure, resource sustainability, and industrial symbiosis, as well as sustainable economic decision analysis. Meanwhile, the engineering chapters will delve into topics such as sustainable supply chain design, energy policies, carbon pricing, green product design and evaluation, green logistics, product-service systems, green smart production, circular economy, and clean production theories and case studies.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技三年級上學期實施選修專項分組教學，課程修畢有一學分並計入畢業學分內。由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: In first semester,  Junior students can choose to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. When they are finishing the course that can get the credit, also can account in graduate credit. For Senior level, Classes are giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 包括應用力學與材料力學兩大部份。課程介紹應力概念、應力與應變、軸向與平面、扭轉、彎曲、樑的撓度、柱、能量方法等。
description.en: Topics covered in design kinematics and Materials phase include: Engineering Mechanics Dynamics, Motion, Vibration, Material Forming Process, Tension, Compression, Shear, Torsion, Bending, Beam, Buckling and Stability.Also included with in this category are the activities as sociated with the preparation of the preliminary brief and the conceptualisation of the problem sloution. The management category emphasises the inevstigation and interpretation of both management functions and principles.

description.zh: 介紹人體之形態特徵、心理期望、動作行為等人因知識，研究人因資訊應用於工業設計實務上之設計方法或準則以獲得具安全、效率與舒適之產品或環境設計。
description.en: Basic Knowledge for Ergonomic

description.zh: 講解新產品開發流程的企畫、設計、製造等知識，並演練運用解決複雜的產品設計開發問題之系統化設計方法、快速手繪以及立體電腦模型表現，延續並運用大一與大二課程所學之美學、人因工程、工學、電腦繪圖等各方面知識與技能。
description.en: Course projects are chosen to give students an opportunity to use their creative, technical and theoretical skills in a business application. The primary emphasis is on the use of a systematic process for the design and development of products.

description.zh: 本課程為整合家具與室內設計之進階課程。藉由相關設計競賽活動或產學合作計畫案，以創意激發的訓練為主，透過實際設計程序的演練，習得設計的方法並培養解決問題的能力。
description.en: This course is an advanced program that integrates furniture design and interior design. Through related design competitions or industry-academia cooperation projects, creativity is emphasized in the training, and students will learn design methods and cultivate problem-solving abilities by practicing actual design procedures.

description.zh: 了解各種珠寶種類材質、製作技術、製造流程及設備並應用設計的基礎能力, 發揮珠寶首飾的設計創意、造形表達；學習珠寶首飾描繪表現技法及基礎製圖法。
description.en: The course is concerned with the design and production of jewellery , siversmithing and related products and is delivered through a programme of lectures and practical design projects in terms of types of materials,techniques ofproduction , and its processes and equipments. Based on the foundation of design skills, the students can practice the techniques of presentation and drawing, and learn how to create new designs of jewellery and its related products.

description.zh: 照明設計基本原理之介紹為'照明設計'之基礎先修課程. 以期學生能獲得照明設計之正確觀點與知識, 內容含燈具與光源之關係, 光的材料特性與色彩, 測光法與光源資料之解釋, 以及照明對人生生理與心理上的影響.
description.en: Course Title:Design of Lighting Description:This course is designed for one-semester program in the lighting. The main purpose of this course is to introduce the softwares and hardwares of lighting. (including lightion equipements. lighting design, transmission system, and distribution system) and how to maintain these equipments.

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養學生成為能夠熟練運用生成式 AI 技術的新時代設計師。通過深入學習生成式 AI 的基本原理與應用，學生將掌握各種 AI 輔助設計工具，如 ChatGPT、Midjourney 等。課程重點培養學生的提示工程技能，使其能夠有效引導 AI 工具產生所需的設計成果。課程致力於幫助學生將 AI 技術整合到傳統設計流程中，同時 AI 輔助程式設計和網頁開發等實踐培養跨領域能力。課程鼓勵創新思維，激發學生探索 AI 技術在設計領域的創新應用。通過小組專案，學生將培養團隊合作精神和專案管理能力。另一方面，注重培養學生對 AI 技術應用的倫理意識，以及持續學習的能力，使其能夠在快速發展的 AI 技術領域中保持競爭力。總體而言，本課程旨在全面提升學生在 AI 時代的設計能力，為他們在數位化轉型的職場中做好充分準備。學生將學習：1. AI 素養 2. 運用生成式 AI 工具進行設計創作 3. 編寫有效的提示以引導 AI 生成所需內容 4. 利用 AI 技術進行圖像和 3D 生成 5. 將 AI 工具整合到現有設計工作流程中 6. 使用 AI 輔助程式設計並完成小專案 7. 評估和應對 AI 應用中的道德和法律問題
description.en: This course trains new-generation designers to proficiently use generative AI technologies. Students will explore the fundamentals and applications of tools like ChatGPT and Midjourney while developing strong prompt engineering skills to guide AI in producing desired design outcomes. The course emphasizes integrating AI into traditional design workflows and building cross-disciplinary abilities through practices like AI-assisted programming and web development. It also fosters innovative thinking, teamwork, project management, and ethical awareness in applying AI within the design field.

name.zh: 生成式 AI 設計實務應用
name.en: Practical Applications of Generative AI in Design

description.zh: 世界經濟論壇 2025 年《就業未來報告》指出，AI 的趨勢正改變就業市場並加速轉型。人工智慧 (AI) 作為一種能表現智慧的技術，已深刻改變了人類與科技產品的互動方式。隨著科技的日新月異，AI 從基本的數據運算逐步發展為具備創造力的工具，其中「生成式人工智慧」(Generative AI) 尤為矚目。 本課程旨在培養學生對圖像生成式 AI 的素養與實務應用。透過多種 AI 繪圖工具的學習與應用，引導學生創作出具視覺吸引力的作品，並幫助設計流程的發展。同時，課程將提供最新的趨勢資訊與實作教學，讓學生能完成具體的創意項目與設計專案。
description.en: The World Economic Forum's 2025 "Future of Jobs Report" indicates that the trend of AI is transforming the job market and accelerating its evolution. Artificial Intelligence (AI), as a technology capable of exhibiting intelligence, has profoundly changed the way humans interact with technological products. With the rapid advancement of technology, AI has evolved from basic data computation to a tool with creative capabilities, with "Generative AI" being particularly noteworthy. This course aims to cultivate students' literacy and practical application of image-generative AI. Through the learning and application of various AI drawing tools, students will be guided to create visually appealing works and assist in the development of design processes. Additionally, the course will provide the latest trend information and practical teaching, enabling students to complete specific creative projects and design assignments.

description.zh: 本課程聚焦於聯合國 17 項永續發展目標 (SDGs)，根據設計思考法及問題導向學習 (Problem-based Learning) 的模式，以同理心分析、問題發想與定義、創意發想、雛型發展與驗證評估，透過課堂講授、移地教學及設計思考工作坊之操作，期望培養學生問題解決能力，並藉由創新提案參與相關設計競賽或募資平台。
description.en: This course focuses on the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) of the United Nations. According to the design thinking method, the problem-based learning (Problem-based Learning) model, empathy analysis, problem thinking with definition, creative thinking, Through the operation of classroom lectures, ex-situ teaching, and design thinking workshops, it is expected to cultivate students' problem-solving ability, and participate in relevant design competitions or fund-raising platforms through innovative proposals.

description.zh: 修完「學院指定向度課程」12 學分後，剩餘 6 學分可在人文與藝術向度、社會與法治向度、自然與科學向度及創新與創業向度自由修滿，達到通識畢業 18 學分。

When they are finishing the course that can get the credit, also can account in graduate credit. For Senior level, Classes are giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 本課程分四年（八學期）教授， 四學年課程培養的核心專業能力如下: ■	第一年 : 以建築設計的基礎為範疇。訓練造型基礎，包括尺度、比例﹑秩序與韻律、實虛、量體與空間等造型的基本設計能力。                                                                                                                                        ■	第二年 ：以人與空間為範疇，並學習建築的內部構成要素。在具備設計基礎能力之後，進一步接觸建築的基本向度與原理的設計練習，包括身體與空間、使用行為模式、建築物理環境、構造與結構系統、建築構成系統、建築的類型與形態。  ■	第三年 ：都市建築為主要範疇。將建築的關注聚焦到與其連結的環境系統或城市紋理，學習從外部環境或都市理論回饋到建築的規劃設計。第四年：即畢業設計，培養學生針對特定建築問題之探究能力，鼓勵以建築思索如何關注社會、文化與自然的課題，最終以設計方案回應之。
description.en: This four-year course will be taught within eight semesters and aims to train students in the core competencies as follows:■ First year: foundations of architectural designTraining of fundamental modeling, including basic designing concepts such as scale, proportion, order and rhythm, solid and void, volume, and space■ Second year: people and space, and internal elements of architectureBeyond competency in elementary design, further practicing basic aspects and principles of architecture design, including human body and space, user behavior model, physical environment of buildings, construction and structure system, architectural composition system, architectural type and form, etc.■ Third year: Urban architectureFocus of environmental system or urban structure relating to architecture, which helps students apply what they have learned from the external environment or urban theory to the planning and design of buildings■ Fourth year: Graduation projectCultivating ca

notes: 新增新聘兼任教師李金威

description.zh: 本課程主要在論述以建築規劃設計者之立場如何利用建築設備系統控制建築物理環境影響因子，以及其與建築物銜接介面之統合關係。本課程為第一階段之系列課程，其內容包括：1. 地球環境變遷對環境控制系統之衝擊 2. 空調設備系統 3. 特殊空調節能設備 4. 電氣設備系統 5. 設施管理 6. 設備更新
description.en: This course mainly discuss issues about architecture planning how a designer uses architecture equipment system to control architecture physical Environmental Impact, and its integrate relation with Building's connecting medium.This course is the first step of a series course, its content including:1. The Impact of Earth Environmental Change to Environmental Control System2. Air Conditional Equipment System  3. Special Air Conditional Energy Conservation System4. Electric equipment5. Facility Management6. Renewal of Equipment System

description.zh: 本課程介紹室外空間設計和建造的理論、原則和方法。 通過案例研究，課程旨在擴大學生對場地規劃主要組成部分的理解。主題集中在六個前提：1。 場地規劃相關理論； 2． 場地規劃的設計順序； 3． 場地調查與分析； 4． 規劃設計方法及其評價； 5． 環境影響評價；6. 案例研究。
description.en: This course introduces the theories, principles, and methods of designing and construction of outdoor spaces. Through cases studies, the courses seeks to expand the students understanding to the major components of site planning.Topics focus on six premises:1. theories in relation to site planning;2. design sequences of site planning;3. investigations and analyses of the sites;4. planning and designing methods and their evaluations;5. environmental impact assessment;6.cases studies.

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹程式設計的基本概念和技術，以及人工智慧的發展和應用。課程內容涵蓋程式語言的基本語法，以及人工智慧的基礎觀念與理論，並藉由編程練習及 AI 工具操作來進一步了解人工智慧應用以及程式設計的潛在應用。
description.en: This course aims to introduce the fundamental concepts and techniques of programming, as well as the development and application of artificial intelligence. The course content covers basic syntax for the programming languages, along with the fundamental concept theories of artificial intelligence. Through programming practices and AI tool manipulations, the students can gain a further understanding of the artificial intelligence application and the potential application via programming.

name.zh: 程式設計與人工智慧導論
name.en: Fundamentals of Programming and Artificial Intelligence

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹施工圖用途及施工法，說明標準施工圖之畫法及標示說明，使學生了解建築工程各種施工法，施工次序及土地管理，加強圖面，作業與實際施工之配合。主要授課內容如下：一、施工圖標準標示法介紹、二、實際建築案例設計並繪製全套施工圖，以及各式施工大、樣圖解說、三、工地參觀、四、工作進度表演練。
description.en: 1. Graphic standards for working drawing. 2. Drawing preparation and process. 3. Selected shop drawing

description.zh: 本課程主要教導學生了解各結構系統的架構及概念，與其受地震力、風力之行為。1. 作用於建築物之荷重、2. 結構材料性質與結構需求、3. 基本應力、4. 受張及受壓結構、5. 桁架結構、6. 樑及構架系統、7. 格子樑、平版及摺板系統、8. 薄膜結構、9. 薄殼結構
description.en: The main purpose of this course is training students to comprehend the concepts and behaviors of each kind of structural systems. 1.Loads on Structures, 2.Structural Materials and Structural Requirements, 3.Fundamental Stress, 4.Tension and Compression Structures, 5.Truss Systems, 6.Beam and Rigid Frames, 7.Grid, Slab and Folded-Plate, 8.Membrane Structures, 9.Thin Shells

description.zh: 先修課程: 負責教授同意學生與教授討論擬定專題研究的題目，在教授的個別指導下，進行實驗研究，並將研究結果寫成報告。
description.en: The topic of the special projects is discussed and together by the students and advisor. Under the face-to-face instruction of the advisor the student will conduct the research and experiments, and the final report at the end of the semester.

description.zh: 先修課程: 4402025 或負責教授同意底盤動力系統，行駛阻力、驅動力、煞車制動傳動等之計算車懸吊系統分析（懸吊系統、汽車垂直振動分析、系統參數調整），汽車轉向系統，ABS 煞車系統，整合系統。
description.en: Traction Force, Driving Resistance, Power Balance, Performance Test, Fuel Economy, Engine and Transmission Matching, Braking Performance, Handling, Steering and Ride Characteristics.

description.zh: 先修課程: 負責教授同意先修課程：負責教授同意。自動控制數學基礎，物理系統的數學模式，控制器的種類，時域分析，穩定性分析，根軌跡法，頻率領域的分析，控制系統的設計。
description.en: Mathematical Foundation of Automatic Control, Mathematical Model of Physical System, Controller Type, Time-Domain Analysis, Stability Analysis, Root Locus Method, Frequency-Domain Analysis, Design of Control System.

description.zh: 先修課程: 物理或負責教授同意不可壓縮流體，質量不滅，非黏性流體之運動，柏努力定律，線性及角動量定理及其應用，渦流與勢流，黏性流，納維爾－史脫克斯方程式及其應用，管中壓力頭損失及增加，邊界層與分離升力與阻力及雷諾方程式之應用。
description.en: Fundamental Concepts, Fluid Statics, Basic Equations in Integral Form for a Control Volume, Introduction to Differential Analysis of Fluid Motion, Incompressibility in Viscid Flow, Dimensional Analysis , Internal in Compressible Viscous Flow, External Incompressible Flow. Introductionto Compressible Flow.

description.zh: 車輛電機實驗內容包括：(1) 發電機、電動機與電瓶實驗；(2) 二極體、電晶體與運算放大器實驗；(3) 電源轉換器與電動機驅動器實驗。學生將學習車輛電機的基本要求，並練習如何應用適當工具設計與製作電路，課程著重學生實作演練。
description.en: This course aims to train students in understanding the fundamental vehicle electrical requirements, and utilizing tools to design and implement the electric circuits. Topics include: (1) Generators, motors, and batteries experiments, (2) Diodes, transistors and operational amplifiers experiments, and (3) Source converters and motor drivers experiments.

notes: 綜科 B05 電力控制實驗室

description.zh: 車輛底盤與結構實驗內容包括: (1) 車輛底盤分析與實驗；(2) 車輛噪音分析與實驗；(3) 車輛結構分析與實驗。學生將學習車輛設計的基本要求，並練習如何應用適當工具求得車底盤與結構系統主要性能，課程著重學生實作演練。
description.en: This course aims to train students in understanding the fundamental vehicle design requirements and utilizing tools to obtain the major characteristics and performance of the vehicle. Topics include: (1) Vehicle Chassis System Measurements, (2) Vehicle Sound Quality Measurements, (3) Vehicle Structure Analyses and Measurements.

Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 由介紹基本熱傳有關現象，配合熱力守恆有關公式之應用，討論各種熱交換環境下應考慮之因素，分析熱傳導、熱對流、熱輻射及相變熱傳之計算方法。並將要更深入地探討在各不同熱傳導系統內所可能形成之熱力分佈現象，以期學習者能以淺入深地對相關熱傳導系統工程設計上培養出最佳能力。
description.en: Introduction of basic heat transfer phenomena, using thermodynamic conservation equations to discuss the parameters under different heat exchange circumstances, heat conduction, heat convection, heat radiation and phase change are analyzed, discussion in depth on the heat transfer problems in application to cultivate heat transfer design capability.

description.zh: 本課程將介紹冷凍工程，以及其設計，內容涵蓋如下：冷凍工程原理，冷凍系統之設備，各種冷凍系統之設計，冷凍負荷計算，冷媒管路之設計與計算，冷凍庫之設計。
description.en: This course introduces the refrigeration engineering and its system design; the contents cover the following topics: the principles of refrigeration engineering, the equipment and designs of different refrigeration systems, refrigeration load calculations, design and calculation of refrigerant piping, and refrigeration storage design.

description.zh: 基本控制系統的動作方式、位置控制、比例控制、積分控制、微分控制、各種組合控制、氣壓控制裝置、電動及電子控制裝置、液壓控制裝置、空調設備上的各種控制包括溫度、壓力、風量、濕度等之控制。
description.en: To provide students with the concepts of control actions: two position control, proportional control, floating control, integral control, derivative control; to familiarize students with pneumatic control devices, fluid control devices, damper & valves, elementary control systems on HVAC & R systems, include: temperature control, humidity control, static pressure control, flow control and so on.

description.zh: 本課程內容包括通風系統基礎，工業通風，排煙設計，空氣過濾、送風系統設計及安裝與測試，以系統設計為重點。
description.en: The contents of this course include the fundamentals of ventilation system, industrial ventilation, exhaust design, air filtration, air moving system design, construction and testing, the focus of this course is on the system design.

description.zh: 本課程介紹語言教學與學習原則，語言習得理論，和語言習得領域重要研究發現。期能建立學生應用語言學知識與日後相關研究的基礎。課程涵蓋主要內容包括：母語習得理論與實踐、第二語言 (外語) 習得理論與實踐、母語習得與第二語言 (外語) 習得之相同與相異處、影響語言習得重要因素 (情性因素與社會文化因素)、語言學習者策略、對比分析、錯誤分析、語言溝通能力、閱讀理論與實踐、 寫作理論與實踐。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to provide an overview of the current state of second language acquisition studies and to familiarize students with major language acquisition theories and fundamental principles of language learning and teaching.  The topics that this course primarily deals with include: theories of first language acquisition; theories of second language acquisition; current issues in language acquisition; age and acquisition; learning styles and learner strategies; affective factors in second language acquisition; socio-cultural factors in second language acquisition; learner language and error analysis; communicative competence; the reading process; and the writing process.

description.zh: 本課程旨在訓練學生公開表達之能力，內容包括語言表達基本原則與技巧、肢體語言與演講要領，備題演講及即席演講演練。
description.en: This course is designed to enable students to develop the principles and skills necessary for public speaking. Included will be guidelines for giving a speech and displaying body language, and practices for prepared speech and impromptu speech.

notes: A 組 - 學號尾號數奇數，僅限英文系學生修讀

description.zh: 本課程介紹研究方法和論文寫作知識，期能培養學生獨立研究和撰寫學術報告、論文的基本能力。主要分為三部份：（一）研究內涵與步驟,（二）主要的研究方法,（三）如何撰寫英文論文及報告。涵蓋主題包括：運用圖書館資源選擇研究主題、研究計劃的撰寫、問卷調查法、訪問法、觀察法、田野工作研究方法、文獻資料分析法（內容分析法）、個案研究法、相關研究法、實驗法、文學研究法，研究報告論文格式與寫作要領，如何撰寫文獻探討，參考書目寫法等。
description.en: This course aims at providing students with the fundamental knowledge and competence that they will need in doing research and writing research papers.  Its main purpose is to familiarize students with methods, procedures, and techniques that are applicable to quantitative and qualitative research as well as to improve their ability to write research papers.  The main topics for instruction include: the research process; major research methods; and the structure of a research paper.  The research methods primarily studied include the experimental method, descriptive research, ethnography, case study, observation, survey research (questionnaire and interviews), content analysis/documentary analysis, and critical approaches to literature.

description.zh: 經理需要以現代管理必要的 "資訊 - 基礎" 來支持，俾使達到和滿足 (相遇) 他們的組織目標。管理資訊系統 (MIS) 是整合使用者和機構系統，用以提供一個組織之操作支援，管理分析，和決策功能。我們以學習資訊工作者的角色，幫助經理滿足 (相遇) 組織目標， 以及檢查資訊系統的特徵，使經理工作更容易順暢。學習主題：透過資訊系統獲取策略優勢、透過資訊系統應用，支持經理和執行、管理固有的冒險，俾使發展和資訊系統應用、獲得和實踐技術性領導
description.en: The need for information-based support for managers is increasing as the modern management imperatives of reach and to meet their organization's goals. A management information system (MIS) is an integrated user + Machine system that provides information to support operations, management analysis, and decision- making functions in an organization. We will also look at the role in formation play in helping managers meet goals by examining the characteristics of information systems that make managers' job easier. Topic of learning:‧Acquiring strategic advantage through information systems.‧Supporting managers and executives through IS applications.‧Managing the risk inherent in developing and using IS applications.‧Attaining and practicing technological leadership.

description.zh: 本課程主要介紹組織內個人之行為以及團體間之種種管理；課程之內容大綱如下：組織行為之功能、組織行為之基礎－個人部份、組織行為之核心、組織動力學、組織行為之過程與結構。
description.en: This course introduces individual behavior in an organization and the management among the organizations. The course is consisted of functions of the organizational behavior (OB), fundamental of OB for individual, core of (OB), and processes and structure of (OB).

description.zh: 以實務性專題提供學生獨立研究、設計、實驗之機會。
description.en: The course uses the practical project to help students to build independent research , design and experiment.

description.zh: 本課程主要了解行銷研究的本質與特性，掌握行銷研究要領，進而具備規劃與執行行銷研究的能力，包含下列：行銷研究的環境與基本觀念，網路資料庫介紹，資料蒐集模式與方法，問卷設計與抽樣，量表製作，資料分析，研究成果呈現與溝通。
description.en: This course aims to help participants understand the nature and features of marketing research, realize how to conduct marketing research, and develop a toolset for the planning and implementation of marketing research. It has the followings: Background of Marketing Research, Introduction to Marketing Research, Database and Data Collection: Types and Methods, Measurement Instruments and Sampling, Data Analysis, Communicating with Research Users

description.zh: 由於產業環境辦化及科技創新速度，影響企業之營運模式。本課程旨在針對在此產業環境辦畫下，企業經營模式之變革與科技創新對經營模式之變革影響。課程中， 除了理論解析外並輔以企業實務個案作研討。
description.en: Due to the change of industry environment and the speed of technological innovation, the business models of enterprise are impacted. The purpose of this course will study the transform of business model and the impact of technological innovation of the business model. In the course, besides the theory will be included, the business practices case will also be covered.

description.zh: 本課程將介紹人工智慧在各種商情預測的技應用，做好商情預測有利於確保企業發展方向的正確性，也能讓企業更能抓住市場脈動而滿足消費者的需求不會造成太多的庫存堆積，保持市場供需的動態平衡。本課程規劃所欲培育人才所需之教學目標包括：（1）學生有能力使用 python 寫各種商業智能程式，包括使用 pandas 模組裡進行商業數據分析與視覺化。使用 numpy，sklearn 機器學習模組來處理迴歸分析問題。使用 keras 模組來進行深度學習的商業預測應用。（2）實作多種商情預測專題。
description.en: This course will introduce the technological application of artificial intelligence in various business forecasts to help students understand the current status of various applications of AI in business forecasts.The teaching objectives required for cultivating talents in this course planning include:(1) Students are able to use python to write various business intelligence programs, including using pandas modules for business data analysis and visualization. Use numpy, sklearn machine learning module to handle regression analysis problems. Use keras modules for business forecasting applications of deep learning.(2) Implement a variety of business forecast topics.

name.zh: 人工智慧跨域商情預測之應用
name.en: The Application of Artificial Intelligence on Business Forecasting

description.zh: 本課程之設計，以介紹資料庫之概念與技術為主。課程重點為關聯式資料庫的相關概念與技術。本課程包括下列主題：資料庫系統簡介、紀錄儲存與檔案組織、索引檔案結構、關聯性模型、關聯性幾何及演算、SQL 查詢語言、關聯式資料庫設計、功能相依性、正規化處理、查詢語言最佳化處理、資料庫系統技術。進階主題包含物件導向資料庫、多媒體資料庫、分散式資料庫、資料庫之平行操作相關問題等。
description.en: This course is designed to introduce concepts and skills essential in the database systems. Relational database will be the main focus with related topics such as relational model, design concepts, and structured query language. The topics to be covered include: introduction to database systems, record storage and file organizations, indexed structures for files, the relational model, relational algebra and calculus, SQL, conceptual and logical design for relational database, functional dependencies, normalization, query optimization and database technology. Advanced topics include object-oriented database, multimedia database, distributed database, and concurrent operations on database.

description.zh: 本實習介紹 ARM CPU 及以 ARM CPU 為核心之微算機系統。內容包含：ARM 之 C 語言工具，ARM 發展環境，Evaluation board 之介紹，Emulator 之介紹，ARM 之 C 語言程式撰寫及偵錯，利用 C 語言控制 I/O，ARM 之組合語言程式撰寫及偵錯，合併 C 及組合語言之程式，中斷之使用，串列 I/O 及並列 I/O 之使用， A/D 及 D/A 轉換之使用，及期末小專題。
description.en: This lab covers the following topics: introduction to C complier used for ARM CPU, Debugger tools for ARM CPU, functions of the evaluation board, usage of the emulator, writing and debugging C language for ARM CPU, writing and debugging assembly language of ARM, combining C and asm codes, issues of using interrupts, usage of various I/O devices, including parallel ports, serial ports, A/D converters, and D/A converters, and term project.

description.zh: 本課程由老師指導學生選定題目，進行該題目之問題定義、分析、設計與製作。專題完成後需撰寫書面報告並公開展示成品。專題範圍包含：1. 多媒體系統 2. 電腦網路 3. 軟體分析與設計 4. 影像與音訊處理 5. 微算機應用
description.en: In this course, the instructor will guide the students to fulfill a special project through the phases of problem formulation, analysis, design and implementation. The final work should be demonstrated in the public along with a written report. The topics include 1.Multimedia systems 2.Computer networks 3.Software analysis and design4.Audio and video signal processing 5.Microprocessor-based applications

description.zh: 先修課程：普通物理、工程數學。 從黑體輻射之頻譜分析開始，引入量子化的概念；進而推出物質與波動之二象性。經由波爾之半古典的氫原子模型，結合量子化的概念以解釋原子結構，並引入薛丁格方程式所求得之波函數與電子之空間機率的關係。再由原子進而推廣至分子及固態物理之能帶理論，應用能帶理論於解釋固態晶體之光、電及熱學等特性，並介紹半導體之應用的基本原理。
description.en: From the analysis of the spectrum of black-body radiation, the concept of quantization is introduced and the duality of matter and wave is also introduced. Combining the idea of quantization and the semi-classical hydrogen model of Bohr, the structure of atom is described. Solving the Schrodinger equation, the deduced wave function is related to the probability of finding the electron in space. The concept of atom is expanded to the molecular and the energy band theory of solid state physics. The energy band theory of solid state physics is applied to account the optical, electrical, and thermal properties of solid states, also the fundamental principles of semiconductors are introduced.

description.zh: 線性電路；電算放大器；二極體；非線性電路應用；接面場效電晶體（JFET）；金屬氧化物半導體場效電晶體 (MOSFET) ；雙極性接面電晶體（BJT）；差動放大器；多級放大器。金氧半電晶體；雙接面電晶體；差動及多極放大器；功率放大器；頻率響應；回授；類比積體電路；濾波器；調諧放大器
description.en: frequency response,feedback and stability,differential and multistage amplifier,operational amplifier,analog integrated circuits.

description.zh: 基本儀器介紹；電子零件之認識；二極體電路（特性）；運算放大器；電晶體電路（特性）；A/D ，D/A 轉換器；類比乘法器。運算放大器應用；線性電壓調整器；電壓參考及電流源；電壓比較器；電壓控制振盪器；鎖相迴路；頻率－電壓轉換器；類比－數位轉換器；數位－類比轉換器；特殊裝置語言合成電路。
description.en: instrumentation, passive component,diode,transistor, operational amplifier,voltage regulator,voltage reference & current source, A/D & D/A converters,voltage controlled oscillator,PLL.

description.zh: 指導學生進行研究專題，以培養其實務的能力，學生必須選一實務專題，由本系教師指導，在畢業前完成成品製作，且需有書面報告。
description.en: This course is to train students to do the research work and to write the papers. Before graduation, students have the ability to do the R/D work. Each student or group must select one research topic or one project and make a proposal or an announcement by professors' instruction.

description.zh: 本課程介雷射之基本特性及雷射光在光學上的應用，內容包括雷射之時間與空間特性、雷射之模態、干涉、繞射、偏振及透鏡之各種像差等實驗。
description.en: This course introduces the fundamental characteristics of lasers and the applications of lasers in optics. It includes the experiments of the temporal and spatial characteristics of lasers, the mode distribution of lasers, interference, diffraction, and the abberations of lenses.

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓同學學習智慧顯示與感測相關的理論與瞭解相關產業動向，除了透過相關產業導師的教導與實地工廠的參訪，讓同學在最短的時間內對台灣智慧顯示與感測有初步的認識，此外，本課程也包含各種液晶元件的實作與其相關光電特性的量測與應用，讓同學能將理論與實務合而為一。
description.en: The main goal of this course is to teach students the theories and related industrial trends of intelligent displays and sensors. This will be achieved through lectures by industry experts and visits to factories, allowing students to gain a basic understanding of the relevant industries in Taiwan within a short period of time. The course will also include hands-on projects focusing on various LCD components and related optoelectronic properties measurement and application. By combining theory and practice, students can gain a comprehensive understanding of intelligent displays and sensors.

name.zh: 智慧顯示與感測含實習 (I)
name.en: Intelligent display and sensing with internship (I)

description.zh: 修完「學院指定向度課程」12 學分後，剩餘 6 學分可在人文與藝術向度、社會與法治向度、自然與科學向度及創新與創業向度自由修滿，達到通識畢業 18 學分。
description.en: After completing 12 credits “designated by the college”, the remaining 6 credits are open for selection form these curriculums: humanities and art, social and legal, nature and science and innovation and entrepreneurship, until a total of 18 credits of the general curriculum are completed for graduation.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技三年級上學期實施選修專項分組教學，課程修畢有一學分並計入畢業學分內。由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: In first semester,  Junior students can choose to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. When they are finishing the course that can get the credit, also can account in graduate credit. For Senior level, Classes are giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的在促進學生進一步瞭解文化典藏加值應用之概念與方法，並著重於文化典藏單位及其所典藏物件之轉化與詮釋。透過本課程之授課內容，學生可培養以下幾個能力：（1）認識文化典藏加值應用之基本概念；（2）理解文化典藏加值應用之原則與倫理；（3）具備文化典藏應用評估、規劃之專業素養。
description.en: The aim of this course is to facilitate students' understanding of the concepts and methods applied to cultural collections' application, with an emphasis on the transformation and interpretation of cultural collections they contain. In this course, students will develop the following skills: (1) understanding the basic concepts of value-added application of cultural collections; (2) understanding the principles and ethics of value-added application of cultural collections; and (3) professional competence in the evaluation and planning of the application of cultural collections.

description.zh: 博物館學課程目的在於培養並建構學生對於博物館發展之史觀，透過理論與實務，讓學生學習及了解博物館的功能性、意義與重要性、價值觀轉變以及後現代性和發展趨勢等議題，使同學對於博物館學有一基礎認識。
description.en: This course aims to cultivate and construct students' historical points of view. Students can learn and understand the function, significance and importance, value transformation, postmodernity, and development trends of museums through theory and practice so that students can have a basic understanding of museology.

description.zh: 本課程始自一系列關於「古代哲學」的演講，特別著重於自然主義哲學家的思想。藉此讓我們得以瞭解下述議題： 宇宙的基本物質、變化問題，與原子論。接下來，我們會探討希臘哲學，著重於: 辯士學派、蘇格拉底、柏拉圖，與亞里斯多德。我們接著探討希臘化時期的學說，然後轉向中世紀哲學，再接著探討文藝復興與巴洛克時期的思想與「現代哲學」的思想家，如笛卡兒、史賓諾莎、洛克、休姆，與柏克萊。藉此讓我們得以瞭解理性主義、經驗主義，與唯心論。接下來，我們會探討：企圖整合理性主義和經驗主義的康德批判哲學，和馬克思的歷史唯物主義。我們會適時插入東方的思想，如儒家、道家、佛教思想作為對比。
description.en: The course starts with a series of lectures on Greek philosophy with a particular look at the Sophists, Socratics, Plato, and Aristotle. Afterwards, we will study the theories and accounts during the Hellenistic period and Medieval philosophy, followed by a close look at thoughts appeared in the Renaissance and Baroque era. The course then focuses on modern philosophers such as Descartes, Spinoza, Locke, Hume, and Berkeley, thoughts concerning Rationalism, Empiricism, and Idealism. We then shall move onto Kant with a particular look at his attempt of combining Rationalism and Empiricism into his Critical Philosophy. Afterwards, we will study Historical Materialism and the theory of Evolution provided by Marx, and Darwin, respectively. If time permitting, we will look at some important oriental thoughts such as Confucianism, Taoism, and Buddhism as a contrast.

description.zh: 導覽解說技巧與實務課程旨在介紹各種不同環境、空間與目的之導覽實務，除了學習制式導覽技能，導覽解說人員亦並時時充實各式導覽內容所需相關知識。課程內容包含導覽解說流程、導覽技巧訓練、操作導覽器具、製作導覽手冊、筆記等。
description.en: The course aims to introduce various practical skills and techniques for guiding in different environments, spaces, and purposes. In addition to learning formal guiding skills, tour guides are also required to constantly enrich their knowledge of relevant content for various tours. The course content includes the process of tour guiding, training in guiding techniques, operating guiding equipment, creating tour guides brochure, note-taking, and more.

description.zh: 本課程旨在引導學生認識文化資產的相關議題，包含基本概念、類別、保存維護、再利用情形，深入了解文化資產的意義與價值，以及管理運用的重要性。介紹國內文化資產保存維護情形、管理組織、政策制定、重要法規及所衍伸出的相關問題等。另搭配實地參訪，探討不同類型文化資產管理實例，幫助學生習得文化資產管理實務知能及相應行政法規。
description.en: This course aims to introduce the administrative regulations of the practice of heritage in Taiwan. Different approaches are conducted to analyse the heritage issues, for example, the cultural interpretation and re-presentation, the authenticity issue, the politics of identity, the conservation issue, and the strategy of reuse and management. Different case studies are also used in the class to help students to have clear understanding of the administrative process and regulation that related to heritage protection in Taiwan.

description.zh: 課程主要目的為結合實際廣告或微電影發想與製作，針對文創商品，人文議題，或文化主題，做一實際的設計發想與製作。透過廣告訊息的創製或微電影的拍攝，將整體構思概念，透過素材選擇，表現手法，鏡頭語言，了解整體廣告與微電影發想與製作過程，將相關創意具體實踐於數位影音作品。
description.en: The main purpose of the course is the advertisement or microfilm think and production, for the cultural and creative goods, cultural issues, or cultural themes, to make a practical design thoughts and production. Created by shooting advertising messages or microfilm, the whole idea of the concept, through material selection, performance techniques, and camera language, designers understand the overall advertising and microfilm distribution and production of thought process, specifically related to the practice of creative works in the digital audio and video work.

name.zh: 創意廣告與微電影製作

description.zh: 當代飾品設計及製作是一門以實作為主，實務講述為輔的設計性課程。透過實務教學進行，提供學生基礎金工珠寶的製作能力並進行應用。課程旨在結合金屬工藝與多元媒材的當代趨勢，引導學生系統性的完成作品後，將透過展演形式發表成果。
description.en: This course will use a combination of lectures, demonstrations, and practical experiences to educate the student in the basic skills required to work as a member of jewelry design discipline. This class will also be an introduction to the multiple media of design. Contemporary Jewelry Design will provide an overview of the professional world of Jewelry design through a practical exhibition.

description.zh: 課程旨在介紹實驗影像的關鍵理論，說明導演與藝術家是如何使用視覺與聲音技術向影像本質提問，以啟動視覺之外感官知覺，進而擴展影像的語言。從早期歐洲前衛電影、城市電影、實驗影像，到台灣近年電影，關切在觀看裡的感官知覺經驗，以回應當代視覺文化裡，數位藝術、新媒體與沈浸式影像創作等的興起。
description.en: The course aims to introduce the key theories of experimental images. Filmmakers and artists employ audio-visual techniques to investigate the nature of images itself, intending to explore sensual perception beyond visuality and expanding the realm of images. Beginning from the early European avant-garde cinema, city symphonies, experimental images to recent Taiwanese films, this course focuses on sensory perception in spectatorship, in response to the emergence of digital art, new media, immersive images, and so on.

description.zh: 陶藝造型是一門以實作為主，實務講述為輔的陶藝設計創作課程。透過實務教學進行，提供學生陶瓷工藝廣泛多元視角的文化創新課程。課程旨在結合陶藝造型能力與陶瓷設計產出思維，從介紹陶藝發展、材料種類、技法使用，到進入實作，並導入工藝生活的精神。學生系統性的完成作品後，將透過展演形式發表成果。
description.en: The Ceramics modeling is a clay creation course supplemented by theory and practice. Through practical teaching, it provides a cultural innovation viewpoint with a wide range of perspectives on the ceramics craftsmanship. The course aims to combine the forming skills of ceramic art with the design thinking, from the ceramic art development, material knowledge, to techniques, and the introducing of the idea of craft in life. After the students have systematically completed the work, they will orginize a group exhibition to show the result.

notes: 上限 15 人；共同科館 9 樓工藝教室上課

description.zh: 修完「學院指定向度課程」12 學分後，剩餘 6 學分可在人文與藝術向度、社會與法治向度、自然與科學向度及創新與創業向度自由修滿，達到通識畢業 18 學分。
description.en: After completing 12 credits “designated by the college”, the remaining 6 credits are open for selection form these curriculums: humanities and art, social and legal, nature and science and innovation and entrepreneurship, until a total of 18 credits of the general curriculum are completed for graduation.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技三年級上學期實施選修專項分組教學，課程修畢有一學分並計入畢業學分內。由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: In first semester,  Junior students can choose to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. When they are finishing the course that can get the credit, also can account in graduate credit. For Senior level, Classes are giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 介紹系統分析的基本概念及方法，深入熟悉開發一個電腦化資訊系統之方法及步驟。包含：系統分析、系統設計、系統建置、系統運轉、系統評鑑等之實施方式及步驟。
description.en: This course introduces the basic concepts and approaches of systems analysis including systems analysis, systems design, systems establishment, and systems evaluation and testing.

description.zh: 財務報表所反映的是企業的經營績效，不同的產業有不同的特質、不同的經營環境，即使在相同的產業中，企業若採行不同的競爭策略，在財務報表上也會有不同的表現。本課程的主要目的是要使學生了解如何透過財務報表，來評估企業的經營績效與價值。本課程將介紹以下內容：1) 基本財務報導與特別科目的報導與分析 2) 基本分析理論 3) 償債能力、獲利能力、經營能力、資本結構、現金流量的分析 4) 特殊行業的財務報表分析 5) 探討我國最近發佈的 7 號、34 號及 35 號會計準則公報對企業與投資人的影響。
description.en: The goal of this course is to help students evaluate the performance and measure the values of firms by financial statements. The topics of this course includes 1) financial reports and analysis of special accounting subjects; 2) basic financial statement analysis; 3) solvency, profitability, business performance, financial structure and cash flow analysis; 4) financial statement analysis of special industries 5) recent developments of GAAP.

description.zh: 本課程的目的一，將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別為：從全球化角度認知社會可接受的商業行為，將待人和善深植於良好的企業中，企業形象再造，強化職業倫理以及投資於可持續發展和有社會責任的公司。本課程亦教導學生瞭解今日快速變化工商界，符合企業倫理的公司治理原則與方式。課程的教導將朝下列五個方向進行：（1）廠商的社會責任，（2）消費者的保護，（3）員工的權益，（4）員工對公司的責任，（5）雇主與員工關係。目的二，進一步教授 ESG 及聯合國 SDGs 指標的基本定義，藉由國、內外的個案討論來深根學生對於企業永續經營的觀念。
description.en: The first objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: recognizing socially acceptable business conduct from the global perspectives, embedding good business in treating people nice and fair, reengineering corporate image, enhancing professional ethics, and investing in sustainable and socially responsible corporations. This course also discusses with the students the corporate governance that follows business ethics in today's changing business society. Five major categories will be covered: (1) Corporate social responsibility, (2) Consumer protection, (3) Employee's rights and benefits, (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms, and (5) Employer-employee relations.The second objective is to further explain the definitions of ESG and SDGs, and then to root the concept of sustainable management to students through local and international case studies.

description.zh: 區塊鏈由比特幣為代表的 1.0，經過以太坊的智能合約為代表的 2.0，進入以設計超級帳本或結合物聯網、人工智慧的 3.0 階段。在各產業的應用也逐漸廣泛，已呈現多元研究及發展的面向，也代表產業型態將因為區塊鏈的發展而發生重大的變革。本課程在帶領學生了解區塊鏈的核心技術、特性，以及目前在各產業的應用實例，並透過從發行數字貨幣到撰寫智能合約的商業應用，看見區塊鏈未來的發展。
description.en: Blockchain is represented by Bitcoin 1.0, and after 2.0 represented by Ethereum's smart contracts, it enters the 3.0 stage of designing a super ledger or combining the IoT and AI. The application in various industries is gradually becoming more and more extensive, and it has presented a multi-faceted research and development orientation. It also represents that the industry type will undergo major changes due to the development of the blockchain.This course leads students to understand the core technology and characteristics of blockchain, as well as current application examples in various industries, and sees the future development of blockchain through the commercial application from issuing digital currency to writing smart contracts.

description.zh: 本門課程是財務、電腦、與數學的結合，其主要目標為啟發學生如何設計電腦演算法來解決財務或經濟上的問題。一開始，此課程會複習一些基本的知識，如利率期間結構、選擇權評價理論、隨機過程模型、數值方法、與寫程式時所需的資料結構。之後，會講到一些新奇選擇權的演算法，包括亞洲式選擇權，障礙選擇權、回顧選擇權、重設選擇權、彩虹選擇權、可轉換公司債。
description.en: The major goal of this course is to provide students with complete understanding of many financial markets and products. Topics such as forward and futures, swaps, and options will be fully covered. In addition, the basic pricing methods of these innovative products will be emphasized in this course. Finally, even to a MBA student, the knowledge mentioned in this course is sure to be helpful for his (or her) future career.

description.zh: 本課程將從不同的金融服務領域應用幫助同學瞭解數位金融的發展以及生成式 AI 於金融科技之應用。本課程之教學目標包括：(1) 人工智慧跨域應用金融產品企劃與數位行銷：掌握虛擬通路與實體通路的差異與整合應用，導入通用式人工智慧搭配合適的使用者介面與體驗設計；(2) 智慧金融科技素養與創新應用：關注大數據、雲端運算、物聯網與人工智慧的各種創新應用，並了解機器學習於資金管理之應用與人工智慧於量化交易之應用；(3) 生成式 AI 導入與開發：透過課程整合微軟 Azure Open AI 雲端服務資源，讓學生具有導入 ChatGPT 及聊天機器人開發能力，並連結創新創業課程建立明確創業目標，導入跨領域創業課程，養成專業職能和研發實力，進而了解金融產業在數位轉型中，所面臨的困難與挑戰。
description.en: 英文概述English Description 	This course will help students understand the development of digital finance and the application of generative AI in financial technology from different financial service applications. The objectives of this program include: (1) Financial product planning and digital marketing; (2) Intelligent financial technology literacy and innovative applications; (3) Generative AI Introduction and Development: Integrate Microsoft Azure Open AI cloud service resources through the course to provide students with the ability to introduce ChatGPT and chat robot development, and link to innovative entrepreneurship courses to establish clear entrepreneurial goals and introduce cross-disciplinary entrepreneurship courses to develop professional functions and R&D capabilities.

name.zh: 人工智慧跨域金融之應用

description.zh: 「金融科技個案與實務」課程旨在透過實務導向的個案分析，結合來自銀行、證券、保險及金融科技產業第一線專家的深度交流，協助學生即時掌握產業脈動與政策變化，並全面理解金融科技於現代金融體系中的應用場景與策略挑戰。課程內容將聚焦於國內外金融科技新創企業的創新商業模式、產品設計及市場推進策略，搭配數位支付平台、虛擬銀行、區塊鏈金融應用等實際案例，深入剖析其營運機制與關鍵成功因素。透過系統化的個案研討與產業互動，學生將培養批判性思維、問題解決與策略分析能力，並深化對金融科技創新與傳統金融機構間合作與競爭關係的理解。課程最終目標為強化學生對金融科技產業之實務掌握與就業競爭力，為其未來投入金融科技或相關領域奠定堅實基礎。
description.en: This course aims to provide students with a practice-driven understanding of FinTech through case-based learning. By integrating industry insights and practitioner experiences from the banking, securities, insurance, and FinTech sectors, students will stay informed about fast-changing market trends and regulatory developments and gain a deeper understanding of the challenges of implementing FinTech in today’s financial systems. The course focuses on the innovative business models, product architectures, and market entry strategies of leading FinTech ventures across both domestic and global markets. Selected topics include digital payment ecosystems, virtual banking, blockchain-enabled financial applications, and other emerging technological innovations. Through case analysis, students will critically evaluate the operational structures and key success drivers of these technologies, preparing them to address complex issues at the intersection of finance, technology, and regulation.

description.zh: 修完「學院指定向度課程」12 學分後，剩餘 6 學分可在人文與藝術向度、社會與法治向度、自然與科學向度及創新與創業向度自由修滿，達到通識畢業 18 學分。
description.en: After completing 12 credits “designated by the college”, the remaining 6 credits are open for selection form these curriculums: humanities and art, social and legal, nature and science and innovation and entrepreneurship, until a total of 18 credits of the general curriculum are completed for graduation.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技三年級上學期實施選修專項分組教學，課程修畢有一學分並計入畢業學分內。由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: In first semester,  Junior students can choose to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. When they are finishing the course that can get the credit, also can account in graduate credit. For Senior level, Classes are giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於介紹使用者經驗設計之理論與應用。藉由本課程的學習，學生能習得互動設計過程中所需要之關鍵概念 - 以使用者經驗為中心之設計。課程以人 - 機 - 境之架構為基礎進行相關知識之講授，並透過案例之研討、方法之操作以及設計實務之進行了解其應用。課程內容包含人物誌、使用者經驗與需求、互動環境、使用者研究以及認知心理基礎等。教學將以課堂講授、個案研討以及方法操作以及設計執行等方式進行，並以作業繳交以及分組討論與發表為評量方式。
description.en: This course is focused on introducing the theories and application of User Experience Design (UXD). In this course, students can understand the key element, UX, of interactive design. This course is set up under the structure of Human-Machine-Scenario theory, and executed through case studies, method simulation and design practice. The contents include personas, user experience and requirements, interactive scenario, user research and cognitive psychology. The course is preceded by means of lecturing, case studies, and design practice. Students are evaluated by design work, group discussion and presentation.

notes: 排一般教室, 限本系生 82 人修

description.zh: 本課程以專案整合的思維，導引學生學習使用者腳本的設計，以及使用者經驗的分析，提出互動科技技術的分析，並以互動程式的撰寫，完成互動科技應用系統的發展與評估。
description.en: This course provides a project-oriented method for students to learn the integration of interactive programming design in the aspect of interaction design, interactive game and interactive arts project development.

notes: 限本系生修 82 人, 大三與外生三合開, 自備筆電

description.zh: 本課程旨在整合應用程式與設計，完成具互動媒體設計作品。為達成此目標，本課程培養學生熟悉與整合互動設計的理論、方法與應用，以具互動性的媒體設計議題，訓練學生獨立創作或分組合作設計，藉此訓練學生創意思考、應用科技與新知的實作能力，同時也可結合產學合作專案於教學活動內，達到務實致用的目標。
description.en: This course applies design and programming into interaction design projects relating to media design. To achieve this goal, students will familiarize the theories, methodology and implications of interactive media design in this course. By interaction design issues, students create and implement ideas by brainstorming through independent study or cooperative learning. For competition without any gap, industry-academic cooperation is one way to prepare student’s critical competencies same as the desired competencies required by the industry.

notes: 限本系媒體組修 (勿選錯組) 轉復學生需修過基本設計 1,2

description.zh: 本課程旨在整合應用程式與設計，完成具互動性的視覺傳達設計作品。為達成此目標，本課程培養學生熟悉與整合互動設計的理論、方法與應用，以具互動性的視覺設計議題，訓練學生獨立創作或分組合作設計，藉此訓練學生創意思考、應用科技與新知的實作能力，同時也可結合產學合作專案於教學活動內，達到務實致用的目標。
description.en: This course applies design and programming into interaction design projects relating to visual communication design. To achieve this goal, students will familiarize the theories, methodology and implications of visual communication design in this course. By interaction design issues, students create and implement ideas by brainstorming through independent study or cooperative learning. For competition without any gap, industry-academic cooperation is one way to prepare student’s critical competencies same as the desired competencies required by the industry.

notes: 限本系視傳組修 (勿選錯組) 轉復學生需修過基本設計 1,2

description.zh: 此概論課程將介紹虛擬實境（VR）及擴增實境（AR）相關技術於現今智慧製造與服務業之應用，並於理論課程之外安排數個實習單元，針對不同技術開發於工作環境及其設計之應用做實作演練。課程中將介紹並展示虛擬實境及擴增實境於不同工作環境及其設計之應用實例，包括：VR/AR 軟硬體操作及體驗、各式追蹤系統介紹與實作（如眼睛追蹤、肢體動作追蹤、手勢追蹤）、VR/AR 相關產業之參訪或演講等等。本課程旨在使學生了解如何將虛擬實境及擴增實境之技術運用在實際工作環境、產品及系統設計，以因應產業趨勢及就業競爭力之提升。
description.en: The introductory course gives an overview about VR (virtual reality) and AR (augmented) technology applied in different workspace and its designs. Various applications and examples of VR and AR applied in workspace design will be demonstrated. The goal of the course is to empower students in learning VR/AR applications and how to apply the techniques in actual work environments, product development and system designs.

name.zh: VR 與 AR 於工作環境設計概論
name.en: Introduction of VR/AR in workspace and its design

notes: 排先鋒教室, 限 40 人修, 自備筆電

description.zh: 互動智慧空間設計著重虛實整合，再加上智慧代理人觀念，結合使用者經驗，促使程式專業人員與互動設計師合作，來發展使用者與環境隨時互動之智慧介面。本課程結合電子、資工、互動領域，針對無人機 (大疆 / Parrot)、生成對抗網路、軟體開發應用 (Open source SDK)、APP 開發、介面設計、小型企業創新研發等主題，由學習者發想設計，並深入發展程式與開發實務。課程內含空間認知與視覺化、空間資訊與介面設計、機器學習、類神經網路、SCRUM、軟體開發測試。相關程式與應用包括 JavaScript、JSON、Firebase、D3.JS、Apache ECharts、CNN、Python.
description.en: This course is integrated with AR、VR、MR, smart agent concepts, and user experiences study.  The purpose is to incorporate programmer and designer in designing a mixed-reality space which is actually a physical space considered as a real-time interface to trig many human-environment interactions. Based on Electronic Engineering, Computer Science and Information Engineering, and Interaction Design, we set study topics as Drones (Dji /Parrot), gan, Open source SDK, APP development, interface design, small business innovation. Students are encouraged to create their own concepts then develop programming. Course contents included of spatial perception and information visualization, spatial information and interface, machine learning, neural network, Scrum, software development and testing. The program and application included of JavaScript、JSON、Firebase、D3.JS、Apache ECharts、CNN、Python.

name.en: Interaction design and programming in a smart space

description.zh: 中文課程共分四年三階段授課。 第一、二年以華語教學為主，授課重點為：（一）華語基本句型句法；（二）華語基本會話；（三）生活語言；（四）標音系統。第三年 (一學期)，除延續第一、二年華語授課重點外，以段落朗讀和基本認字為主要訓練，並給與中國文字書寫訓練。 第四年 (一學期)，加強會話能力，認字與閱讀能力，並傳授中國文化。
description.en: The course of Chinese is categorized as three individual stages for four years. In the first year, the course focuses on: (a) Basic Sentence Patterns, (b) Basic Conversation, (c) Languages in the Real Life and (d) the phonetic system for the Chinese language. In the second and the third year (one semester), the training focuses on paragraph reading and term/character recognition-in addition to the teaching themes set in the first year. Writing courses are also added during this stage. In the fourth year (one semester), we add more emphasis on the conversational ability, term/character recognition and reading ability. More culture-related information will be included.

description.en: This course aims at providing students the knowledge of projector and screen. Case studies allow students to understand varying types of projection art, including 2D projection on wall, 3D projection on building, spherical projection and holographic projection.
